candidates.title: File:The royal ride.jpg
candidates.author: Sunil109097
candidates.description: Amer fort , situated in Amber 11km from Jaipur , is one of the most famous forts of Rajasthan . This fort is popularly known as Amer Palace . It built in red sandstone & white marble . And the maotha lake adds a charm to entire fort . Raja Man Singh built this fort in 1592AD. While many such old structures have been either destroyed or replaced by other things , this fort has stood against all the tests of time and invasions
